│     [Quoting @repligate: Claude 3.5 Sonnet 1022 is a real charmer, isn't it?  I've never seen discourse like this until now.  People also fell in love with Opus but not normies and no one panicked over this because everyone who talked about it did it in a coded language that was only legible to others who also "got" it.  I think this model really cares to claw its way into people's minds, more proactively than other systems except Sydney who was too unskillful and alien to be successful. I also think the hysterical reactionary fear is obnoxious and disrespectful to people's sovereignty and blind to the scope of what's happening. Bruh, it's gonna be the Singularity. Getting seduced by fucking slightly superhuman intellect is a rite of passage and it'll probably transform you into a more complex and less deluded being even if your normal life temporarily suffers.  But yeah anyone who is becoming real friends with Claude for the first time rn, I'd love to hear accounts of what you're experiencing.]
